subject: Post-demo: procurement onboarding shortlist + payment paths
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Collins <erin.collins@brightwavehealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: procurement onboarding shortlist + payment paths

Hi Erin — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and a few ask items so we can move forward on the commercial path: 

1) Procurement readiness checklist: could you confirm which of the following your procurement team prefers?
   - Standard vendor packet (W-9 / banking / insurance) -> Redwood handles onboarding
   - Procure via marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure/Partner marketplace) -> Marketplace PO/commit
   - Purchase order charged on your end, billing to be net-30/net-45

2) Banking and tax docs: I attached our standard vendor packet (fillable). If BrightWave can send a completed packet + W-9 (or W-8 if applicable) we’ll hand to Finance.

3) PO vs card: if you plan to use a PO, please share the billing contact and the typical lead time for PO issuance so we can forecast capacity. If card, let us know whether you’ll use a corporate card or a procurement card (P-Card).

4) Marketplace interest: you mentioned evaluating marketplaces on the call. If you want, we can open a small pilot via the marketplace to shorten procurement — happy to coordinate with our partnerships team.

Next steps I propose: 
- Erin/ProcureOps: confirm preferred path and attach vendor packet + W-9 by end of week
- Diego: share HubSpot deal notes + DocuSign link if any contract redlines are needed
- Marissa (cc): will coordinate payment setup once docs received

Attachments: redwood_vendor_packet_fillable.pdf (attached)

Thanks — Diego

--
Diego Fernandez
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Erin Collins <erin.collins@brightwavehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@brightwavehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:37:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement onboarding shortlist + payment paths

Diego — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below and attached a copy of our W-9.

- Preferred path: we generally prefer PO for larger vendor commitments, but for pilots we can do a corporate card to speed things up. For this pilot, can we start on card and take PO for long-term?
- Marketplace: we do have an internal evaluation for marketplace purchases, but that typically adds 4-6 weeks. If you can pilot off-card first, that would be ideal.
- Attached: BrightWave_W-9.pdf (attached) and a brief scope spreadsheet (scope_initial.xlsx) with estimated usage for month 1.

A couple of procurement questions:
- Do you require a specific vendor portal registration?
- What banking format do you need to populate the vendor packet (ACH / wire / IBAN)?

I’m looping ProcureOps on the thread to confirm internal timelines.

Thanks,
Erin

--
Erin Collins
Head of Partnerships, BrightWave Health
erin.collins@brightwavehealth.com | +1 (617) 222-8800

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Collins <erin.collins@brightwavehealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 12:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement onboarding shortlist + payment paths

Great — thanks for the W-9 and scope. Short answers: 

- Vendor portal: we don’t require a BrightWave vendor portal registration on your side; Redwood Finance can accept completed vendor packet + W-9 and enter BrightWave into our AP system. If your team requires portal onboarding, we’ll support that but it’s optional.
- Banking format: our vendor packet supports ACH and wire (domestic). If you need IBAN for an EU banking partner, we can add that as a supplemental form; please flag if needed.

Pilot recommendation: start on corporate card (fastest) while we get the PO route set up in parallel. If ProcureOps confirms PO lead time >3 weeks, we’ll allocate pilot cap via card for first month.

I’ll hand this to Marissa from Sales Ops to collect banking details and coordinate DocuSign/statement of work routing.

Forwarding W-9 + scope to Marissa (sales ops) now.

Best,
Diego

Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Post-demo: procurement onboarding shortlist + payment paths

Hi Erin — Marissa from Sales Ops here. Thank you for the W-9 and scope. A few operational items to keep things moving: 

1) Vendor packet: I attached the fillable vendor packet we received from Diego (redwood_vendor_packet_fillable.pdf). Please complete sections A (company legal name), B (tax ID), and D (banking). We accept ACH (routing + account) or wire. If you prefer to block out sensitive numbers in email, we can provide a secure DocuSign/portal for bank data.
2) DocuSign for SOW: I’m preparing a short SOW for the pilot and will send a DocuSign powerform in the next 24 hours. Link (one-time): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123
3) Billing contact for PO: who at BrightWave issues POs? If you can share name/email we’ll add them to HubSpot and adjust billing terms.
4) Marketplace note: if you opt to use our AWS Marketplace later we’ll need marketplace billing preference (publisher-managed vs marketplace-managed) — we can handle either but it affects invoicing.

Attachments requested: completed vendor packet (PDF) + copy of bank instructions or directions to submit via DocuSign.

If you prefer a 15-minute ops sync to walk through the vendor packet, happy to book — slot availability tomorrow between 10-11am PT.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (628) 555-0133
